complexity.scope: Labels use original benchmark metadata and shared input tokens only. No candidate success, output length or timing enters assignment. Levels, subjects and input length are observational correlates, not causal interventions. Empty groups remain explicit. No additional generation, fitting, distinct examples or held-out/reserve access. 10000 paired request bootstrap samples for descriptive throughput only. Conservative exact paired intervals for accuracy differences. No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory subgroup claim.
complexity.selection: Six original 8192-update dense/linear/MLP contrasts; complete controls, continuations and subject strata remain in the source and tables.

memory.scope: One synthetic prompt per length, two reversed-order repetitions; descriptive memory diagnostic, not independent samples. Peak allocated includes model weights and both resident mapper copies. Not reserved memory or a task-quality result.

native_compression.parameter_formula: Dense k-tap projection: k*4096*4096; rank-r factorization: r*(5*4096+4096)
native_compression.scope: Separate frozen 64-question GSM8K sets, 2048 output cap; own-native end-to-end throughput. DFlash one/two-layer students and EAGLE inherited initialization with short/long fitting; all five arms shown in each experiment. Parameter counts are projection-only, not full deployment memory.

quality.scope: Primary Qwen BF16/SDPA runs only; paired request-bootstrap accuracy intervals, hash/length token equality; not pooled with exact FP32-target family or batch-invariant BF16 rollout extensions.

scope: Retrospective visualizations of completed experiments; no additional fitting, generation, selection or pooling across numerical runtimes.
